summary_1line: Amva seeks ascetic life after rejection; her grandsire Hotravahana advises her to seek Parashurama’s help against Bhishma.

image_candidates.scene_text: The aged sage Hotravahana, trembling with emotion, lifts the sorrowful Amva onto his lap in the forest hermitage.
Amva, pale and tearful among gathered ascetics in a forest clearing, begs to renounce the world and practice severe austerities.
The hermits sit in a woodland circle debating Amva’s fate as the newly arrived ascetic Akritavrana is welcomed with ritual hospitality.
